articles.title: Iran war live: 4 tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump says conflict will end soon

events.summary: The IRGC stated four tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz amidst conflict. Donald Trump stated that the war on Iran will wrap up soon.
events.why: Attacks on maritime tankers in the Strait of Hormuz threaten global energy supplies and risk uncontrolled international escalation.

articles.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war

events.summary: Russia and Ukraine are using AI-powered drones to enhance speed and capability on the battlefield. President Zelenskyy warned that AI could begin leading battlefield decisions by next year.
events.why: The transition to autonomous, AI-driven decision-making fundamentally alters modern warfare and military ethics.

articles.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election

events.summary: A high-speed train collision that killed 68 people has sparked serious concerns about the safety of Spain's rail network. This marks the country's second fatal train disaster this year ahead of a national election.
events.why: A catastrophic mass-casualty rail disaster exposes critical infrastructure vulnerabilities and influences imminent national elections.

articles.title: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia

events.summary: Student List MPs in Serbia are demanding the resignation of top figures after ousting Aleksandar Vučić's party from power.
events.why: Marks a major political transition and potential institutional overhaul following an election upset in Serbia.

articles.title: Poland’s president joins protest amid constitutional crisis at top court

events.summary: Poland's president cut short an overseas trip to Senegal to join protesters facing off with police amid a constitutional crisis at the top court.
events.why: A direct confrontation between the head of state and law enforcement signals an escalating constitutional breakdown in a major EU democracy.

articles.title: Poland: Protesters clash with police over sacked court chief

events.summary: Protesters clashed with police following the firing of top court President Bogdan Swieczkowski. Prime Minister Donald Tusk defended the removal as an effort to restore the rule of law.
events.why: Reflects deep institutional friction and civil unrest over judicial control in Poland.

articles.title: Brazil's new anti-gang law: Can it curb organized crime?

events.summary: A new Brazilian law aims to suppress drug cartels in Rio's favelas following a massacre that killed over 130 people last year.
events.why: Changes in anti-gang legal frameworks directly influence public security, policing tactics, and civil rights in Brazil's urban centers.

articles.title: US appeals court again rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots

events.summary: The 9th Circuit Court rejected a petition to remove 20,000 ballots from California's vote count, ruling the bid unconstitutional.
events.why: Affirms the protection of certified ballots against legal challenges aimed at altering election results.

articles.title: Israel demolishes homes of Palestinians blamed for attack on soldiers

events.summary: Israel demolished the homes of Palestinians blamed for an attack on soldiers and detained at least 12 people. Nearly 5,000 residents remain displaced across Hebron neighborhoods.
events.why: Highlights punitive demolitions and large-scale displacement that exacerbate conflict and violate human rights.

articles.title: Swiss supreme court upholds Liberian ex-rebel commander’s 20-year sentence

events.summary: The Swiss Supreme Court upheld a 20-year sentence for Liberian ex-rebel commander Alieu Kosiah. He was convicted of killing civilians and unarmed soldiers, looting, and crimes against humanity.
events.why: Reinforces universal jurisdiction and legal accountability for international crimes against humanity.

articles.title: How has the ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky been unfolding?

events.summary: A temporary ceasefire is unfolding in the devastated, Russian-occupied town of Oleshky.
events.why: Ceasefires in active combat zones affect civilian survival and local frontline dynamics in the war.

articles.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked

events.summary: Economists expect an upcoming GDP report to show fragile economic growth ahead of Election Day. Meanwhile, Israeli election counts show no clear winner after 90% of ballots were tallied.
events.why: Economic growth data informs policy decisions and voter sentiment prior to national elections.

articles.title: Germany takes cautious approach on Israeli election results

events.summary: German politicians are delaying responses to Israeli election results while awaiting coalition developments. Many officials hope the eventual government will exclude religious hardliners.
events.why: Diplomatic ties and Middle East policy depend heavily on the ideological makeup of Israel's upcoming governing coalition.
